TMC MP Kirti Azad has sparked a political controversy after saying he will never visit the Ram Temple in Ayodhya. He questioned Lord Ram’s treatment of Goddess Sita and explained why he considers Sita a mother figure. BJP leaders Pradeep Bhandari and Sudhanshu Trivedi have criticised his remarks. Here's what Kirti Azad said and how the BJP reacted.
